attribution_definitions.absolute_margin_gradient: absolute derivative of post-intervention gold margin with respect to steered scores
attribution_definitions.attention_total_variation: mean half-L1 distance between pre- and post-intervention attention rows
attribution_definitions.combined_evidence: quantum readout times normalized value influence
attribution_definitions.first_order_gold_margin_delta: sum of score gradient times the applied score residual
attribution_definitions.positive_margin_gradient: positive part of the post-intervention gold-margin score derivative
attribution_definitions.quantum_readout: squared quantum-state overlap used by the selector
attribution_definitions.raw_value_influence: norm of the exact leave-one-out attention-output delta before normalization

hypothesis_assessment.interpretation_limit: Gradient and first-order margin quantities are local attribution proxies. They establish correlation, not a causal proof.
